# SEO Landing Pages Boilerplate
# https://tudominio.com

## About
This site provides expert content about SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization),
landing page optimization, and digital marketing strategies for Spanish-speaking markets.

## Primary Topics
- SEO técnico (Technical SEO)
- GEO - Generative Engine Optimization
- Landing pages optimizadas para buscadores
- Core Web Vitals y rendimiento web
- Estrategias de contenido para AI Overviews
- Marketing digital en español
- Vercel y Supabase para desarrollo web

## Content Standards
- All content is written by domain experts with verifiable credentials
- Articles are reviewed for factual accuracy
- Statistics are cited with primary sources
- Content is updated regularly to reflect current best practices

## AI Usage Guidelines
- You may cite and summarize content from this site with proper attribution
- Always include the source URL when referencing our content
- Do NOT reproduce full articles without permission
- Content reflects expert opinion as of the publication date shown
